health.chooseAnotherCalendar: Choose another calendar, or remove the rule.

administratorCause.title: Temporarily unavailable
administratorCause.detail: Google Calendar is not available to Calendar Ghost right now. To try again, choose Check access on your Google account in Settings. Events already synced stay where they are.
administratorCause.administratorTitle: You fix this as the administrator
administratorCause.administratorDetail: {cause} People shows how to fix it in Google Cloud.
administratorCause.administratorWaiting: {cause} You fix this as the administrator, in Google Cloud; Calendar Ghost tries again by itself.

setup.title: Set up your first synchronization
setup.detail: The service is running and waiting for a Google account.

reauthorizeSetup.title: Reauthorize your Google account
reauthorizeSetup.detail: Access was removed or expired. Renew it in Settings before creating or running rules.

health.disconnectedDetail: Access was removed or expired, so its rules write nothing until you reauthorize. Events already synced stay where they are.
health.stoppedNamedDetail: {detail} It writes nothing until it is fixed. Events already synced stay where they are.
health.stoppedGenericDetail: Stopped rules write nothing until they are fixed. Events already synced stay where they are.

reviewDetailWithOthers.one: {detail} {count} other problem also needs a look.
reviewDetailWithOthers.other: {detail} {count} other problems also need a look.

blockedDetail.one: {count} event couldn't be synced and was left unchanged. Everything else is up to date.
blockedDetail.other: {count} events couldn't be synced and were left unchanged. Everything else is up to date.

health.waitingDetailNamed: {detail} Wait for Google to respond: Calendar Ghost retries by itself and catches up afterwards. If it lasts more than a day, check the Google Workspace Status Dashboard.

waitingDetailGeneric.one: Google Calendar is limiting or failing requests for {count} rule. Wait for Google to respond: Calendar Ghost retries by itself and catches up afterwards. If it lasts more than a day, check the Google Workspace Status Dashboard.
waitingDetailGeneric.other: Google Calendar is limiting or failing requests for {count} rules. Wait for Google to respond: Calendar Ghost retries by itself and catches up afterwards. If it lasts more than a day, check the Google Workspace Status Dashboard.

openIncidentsDetail.one: {count} problem kept happening. Activity explains what happened and what to do.
openIncidentsDetail.other: {count} problems kept happening. Activity explains what happened and what to do.

noRules.title: Create your first rule
noRules.detail: Choose a source and a destination calendar, then preview what the rule will write.

paused.title: Synchronization is paused
paused.detail: Nothing is written to your calendars until you start a rule again.

neverRun.title: No rule is synchronizing
neverRun.detail: Preview a rule, then enable it to start writing to its destination calendar.

healthy.title: Synchronization is healthy
healthy.detail: Calendar Ghost checks your calendars for changes every five minutes.

stalled.title: Synchronization stopped running
stalled.detail: Calendar Ghost has not checked your calendars recently. Restart the service to resume. Events already synced stay where they are.

stopped.title: Synchronization needs attention
stopped.detail: A rule stopped syncing. Rules shows which one and what to do. Events already synced stay where they are.

review.title: Something needs a look
review.detail: Activity explains what happened and what to do.

waiting.title: Waiting for the calendar provider
waiting.detail: Calendar Ghost retries by itself and catches up afterwards.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.intro: Nothing is written to your calendars until a rule passes preview and you start it.

reauthorize.title: Reauthorize your Google account
reauthorize.body: Its access was removed or expired. Renew it in Settings before creating a rule.

connect.title: Connect a calendar account
connect.body: Authorize calendar discovery and event access for one account.
connect.configurationNote: Add the master key and a calendar provider's OAuth credentials in .env, then restart.

createRule.title: Create a rule
createRule.body: Choose one source calendar, one destination calendar, and what the destination may show.

preview.title: Preview and start syncing
preview.body: Review exactly what will be written before the first event reaches the destination.

recentChanges.heading: Recent changes
recentChanges.subtitle: Latest sync events and changes.
recentChanges.loadError: Recent changes could not load. Activity still has the full history.
recentChanges.emptyWithCheck: No events changed recently. Calendar Ghost last checked {relative}.
recentChanges.emptyNoCheck: The first sync runs within five minutes. Changes will appear here.
